sourceText:
Shrimp, Sausage & Spaghetti
By: Lady Catherine ...
Published: Sunday, December 27, 2009 - 3:25pm

Ingredients




7 cloves of garlic – chopped
1/2 pint grape tomatoes – halved
juice of 1 lemon
1 cup parsley – chopped
1 bunch of scallions – chopped
1/4 cup olive oil
1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes
1 tablespoon dried oregano
2 pounds frozen raw shrimp
4 sausage links
1 box favorite spaghetti
Romano cheese for garnish

Preparation

1 Prepare sausage in pan and set aside. 2 In a container combine tomatoes, garlic, lemon juice, parsley, scallions, red pepper flakes, olive oil, dried oregano and raw shrimp and place in a covered container in the refrigerator for an hour or so. 3 In a heated frying pan add the marinating shrimp and let it sauté.   Cut up the sausage and add it to the frying pan. 4 Prepare the spaghetti as directed on box.  Drain and add to the shrimp and sausage.

About


This is such a very satisfying meal along with a crusty loaf of bread and a red checkered tablecloth!
Enjoy!
